title: Minimal Cumulant Order for Proxy Identification in Latent-Confounded Linear Non-Gaussian Models
banked_reason: The promised all-ell exact depth characterization has been replaced by exact cases ell=1,2,3 plus bounds/asymptotics and an unresolved ell>=4 frontier.
gap_reasons: The promised all-ℓ exact depth characterization has been replaced by exact cases ℓ=1,2,3 plus bounds/asymptotics and an unresolved ℓ≥4 frontier; retitle and position the delivered kernel as this partial frontier rather than the promised universal exact theorem.
The first remaining elbow is (ℓ,R)=(4,3): decide its complete saturated target projection and certify every surviving real branch against the finite-atomic moment constraints.
proof_attempt_summary: The run built a legal finite-atomic cumulant model, proved exact depths for one, two, and three latent confounders, and supplied general upper/lower bounds, recovery charts, and collision-aware inference.  The fixed all-ℓ promise collapsed because every ℓ≥4 intermediate-order fiber remained open; even the first (4,3) case requires a new 31-dimensional saturated elimination and legal-real branch analysis, so the delivered partial frontier cannot be banked under the original universal claim.
tldr: Higher-order cumulants identify the treatment effect in the fixed single-proxy latent-confounded LiNGAM, but the published order \(k(\ell)\) is only sufficient. The proved frontier now has exact depths \(r_\beta(1)=r_\beta(2)=3\) and \(r_\beta(3)=4\), global bounds with matching square-root asymptotics, and terminating algebraic recovery maps with explicit instability certificates. The mandatory complete \((\ell,R)=(2,3)\) test has a linear target eliminant: on \(\det(M_3)a_1\ne0\), every legal representation has \(\beta=-a_0/a_1\), and the unequal-effect incidence saturation is empty. Exact finite depths for \(\ell\ge4\) remain open, beginning at \((4,3)\). The class bridge distinguishes the paper's centered, realizable finite-atomic truncation from Tramontano et al.'s larger unrestricted diagonal-cumulant chart while showing that finite-support converse twins transfer to their actual-law class and that the upper contraction algebra transfers to their generic chart.
gap: The nearest paper proves identification from pairwise cumulant roots through \(k(\ell)\) and claims a one-latent order-three lower result; it does not determine the minimum information depth of the complete ternary law, and its algebraic projection argument does not restrict the extra root to realizable centered source moments with positive variances.
fill: The paper will provide the exact finite-\(\ell\) depth on the finite-atomic quantified-real observable image, a finite established rational atlas with explicit nonvanishing domains and a common failure output off those domains, legal-real converse fibers at all lower orders, an auditable real-infeasibility certificate for the additional one-latent algebraic root, and inference that switches from a proved separated Wald chart to total confidence-fiber inversion at the discriminant. At \(\ell=3\), the exact theorem replaces the published sufficient input \(C_{\le7}\) by the sharp \(C_{\le4}\) requirement and rules out point identification from \(C_{\le3}\) on the stated open locus.
